Title: Why You Smell Sour the Morning After Whiskey or Wine

Description:
Body odor — if you notice a sour, sharp smell the morning after whiskey or wine, pay attention. Your liver breaks alcohol down into acetaldehyde first, and that compound itself carries a sharp, sour smell that escapes through your breath and skin.

Dark spirits like whiskey and wine carry far more congeners than clear spirits like vodka, so they take longer to clear. Body chemistry matters too — many people process it more slowly, so it lingers longer.

Sweating it out won't speed things up. Your liver only processes about one drink an hour — staying hydrated and giving it time is what actually works.
